tvShow.name: The Traitors
tvShow.overview: Welcome to The Traitors — a ruthless reality show hosted by the enigmatic Karan Johar. Here 20 players will openly betray each other in daily eliminations to compete for a grand prize . Hidden amongst the innocent players are the traitors who are out to murder each night. In this ruthless game, trust is rare and betrayal everywhere.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Twenty players enter the palace with one chilling warning: trust no one. Who among them will become the deceitful Traitors? The game begins…

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As the traitors commit their first murder, the players truly understand what they have signed up for. Can the innocents strike back?

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Players take on a gruelling mission to secure the coveted shield - the only protection against murder. A blast from the past heightens suspicions leaving the players with an “identity crisis”.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The Traitors receive a daring secret mission to be executed in plain sight. Will it blow their cover?

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: One Player must make the ultimate choice, while chaos erupts at the Circle of Shakk and suspicions run wild and alliances unravel.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Four players wake up with a target on their back, fated to be murdered by the end of the day! The players can save only one, who will it be?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Party time in the mansion brings out people's true colours as the Traitors pull off a secret mission.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A shocking annoucement forces players to retrace last night's party. Later, they must embarks on a long march with death for one player waiting at the end of the road.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The Players journey comes full circle with a mission that poses the same question they faced at the very beginning- TRUST!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The Traitors India is back. Twenty-one new players arrive eager to begin the ultimate game of trust and betrayal, only to be stopped in their tracks by a shocking roadblock before they even set foot inside the palace.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As the Traitors commit their first murder, the players get a terrifying taste of danger at breakfast. With Shields up for grabs in the mission and the first Circle of Shaq looming, can the Innocents strike back?

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The Traitors are playing the Innocents like a piano, but can the Innocents change the tune? A ruthless mission built on betrayal and dhoka pushes fragile alliances to breaking point and leaves relationships hanging by a thread.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The Traitors embark on their first secret mission, setting in motion an unpredictable high-stakes game where one wrong move could mean Death.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: This mission brings back more than just money. The Traitors and Innocents trade heavy blows in a never seen before Circle of Shaq. Will this explosive new twist shatter trust for good?

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The Innocents find themselves armed with clues that could unravel the Traitors' carefully crafted deception. With the game at a turning point, can the Traitors evade detection and maintain control of the palace?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The Traitors deliver their most devastating blow of the game, eliminating a prized Innocent and leaving the palace shaken. As anger replaces grief, will the Innocents be able to exact their revenge?

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The players step out draped in gold, but beneath the glitter lies a deadly secret. One of them has been cursed by the Traitors and marked for destruction. But for the first time ever, the Innocents are given an extraordinary power: a chance to break the curse and thwart the Traitors' plan.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: One step away from the Finale, the game takes a dangerous turn. A powerful new advantage gives the players the chance to uncover a hidden identity. With stakes at an all-time high, whose cover is about to be blown?

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Trust is dead, and everyone is a suspect. As the game reaches its explosive end, will the Traitors pull off one final act of deception and steal the prize, or will the Innocents finally expose them and claim victory yet again?
